customer_decision_state: The customer is high-consideration and aspirational: authored status, desired self-image or specialist authority creates desire, but rational proof must survive into commitment.
first_persuasive_job: Establish credible aspirational authority, then translate that authority into proof, offer confidence and a state-appropriate commitment path.
fit_boundary: Premium visuals alone do not qualify. The Family is selected when aspirational/editorial authority is genuinely part of the decision and must persist into rational commitment. Feasibility never chooses the Family.

reference_companies.decision_state: Customer is high-consideration and aspirational, seeking both authorship and specialist proof.
reference_companies.within_family_distinctiveness: Specialist portfolio/editorial craft and collaborative expertise can carry authority; proof should resolve into practitioner/specialist confidence.

reference_companies.decision_state: Customer is motivated by desired self-image and needs enough program proof to commit.
reference_companies.within_family_distinctiveness: Transformation imagery, contemporary studio energy and program states must differ materially from kakimoto's specialist/editorial portfolio logic.

compatible_module_grammar.role: distributed proof that sustains authority beyond the opening
authored media/atmosphere with a decision role
emotional resolution without unsupported status promise

registry_boundary.required_behavior: Do not create a fixed F03 hero template to fill this gap. Author the first view from verified aspirational authority + compatible gallery/story/proof grammar, then human-review screenshot gestalt and hero silhouette.

prohibited_or_misfit_grammar: luxury photography or huge type as the sole basis for F03
generic magazine/editorial shell reused across companies
F04 provenance/craft story dominating when maker/process is actually the gating trust mechanism
F01 atmosphere-led opening when sensory state rather than authority is the first job
proof wall that destroys the aspirational opening instead of staging a deliberate handoff

art_direction_contract.hero: Create a company-specific authority silhouette from specialist authorship, transformation aspiration or brand worldview. No family-level fixed hero is allowed.
art_direction_contract.media: Use portfolio, specialist, transformation, studio or authored brand-world media only with safe provenance. Media must establish authority or desired self-image, not simply look premium.
art_direction_contract.typography: Editorial scale shifts, controlled asymmetry and high-contrast hierarchy are allowed when they express actual authority. Repeated generic luxury serif treatment across references is a template failure.
art_direction_contract.density: Low-to-medium early density; proof and offer specificity increase as commitment approaches. Preserve a deliberate authority→proof→commitment handoff.
art_direction_contract.cta: Consultation/trial/booking CTA should feel like the next rational step after authority/proof, not a disconnected sales button.
art_direction_contract.responsive: Mobile must preserve authored hierarchy and authority rather than flattening into a generic stacked landing page. 320–430px optical Japanese line composition is a hard human-visible gate.

collision_rules.discriminator: F03 when premium/aspirational authority and authored visual status lead; F04 when authority must resolve first into human/material provenance and craft process.
collision_rules.human_review_trigger: premium authority is inseparable from a founder/maker narrative

collision_rules.discriminator: F03 when aspirational status/desired self-image leads; F01 when sensory experience/lifestyle fit leads.
collision_rules.human_review_trigger: sensory worldview and premium authority are co-equal in the verified decision state

collision_rules.discriminator: F03 when authority/desire leads and proof supports commitment; F06 when mechanism/process credibility is the gating question from the outset.
collision_rules.human_review_trigger: specialist authority and mechanism efficacy must both be proven before any persuasive progress

anti_template_requirements: kakimoto arms and pilates K must not share hero silhouette, grid, proof sequence, image masks or CTA rhythm merely because both are F03.
Compared with uka F04, kakimoto may share human expertise but must lead with aspirational/specialist authority rather than provenance intimacy.
Compared with F01, pilates K can use emotional/transformation media but must preserve an authority/proof/commitment handoff rather than atmospheric rest grammar.
The absence of a dedicated F03 hero pattern increases human-review importance; it does not authorize a new fixed template.
Color/photo/logo/copy substitution alone is a template-swap failure.

production_feasibility_separate_profile.allowed_effect: After Family freeze, may safely alter media realization and proof placement according to rights/evidence availability while preserving the authority→proof→commitment logic.
